text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Less than a month remains until the Arima Kinen.
Biwa Hayahide's running form is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Their movements are stiff overall. Their body might be tense
with our long-awaited showdown finally ahead of us.
choice_data_list: Let's take a deep breath for now, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *exhale*...
choice_data_list: (...Her breathing might still be a bit shallow.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the course time limit is fast approaching.
As the surrounding Umamusume leave the track,
what can I do for her right now—?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Deeeeeeeeep breath in!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Hayahide, together now!!
Inhaaaaaaale~~~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. Ticket, even if you're trying to help,
there's a right way to do things.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...Hayahide. Lift your head up.
It makes your head look even bigger than usual."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wha--!? My head is--

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Look. Your back's straighter than before.
Isn't it easier to breathe like that?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nothing. It's not something to thank me for.
You standing around like a deer in headlights was just in the way, so I made a suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Our reserved time is ending soon.
Which means this course isn't just for you guys.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You say that, but Taishin, you were the first one to notice Hayahide was having trouble!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, truly.
It's far more than I deserve."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, since we're all here,
why don't we run one last lap together?
To get ourselves pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ehh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Taishin and Hayahide too!
Here we goooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: DEEEEEERRRBBYYYYY!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm telling you, the Derby ended ages ago.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yet, seeing that unchanging presence over the years
has given us new insights and courage.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am truly grateful.
To have met you all, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, cut the small talk.
............So?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You're running too, right, Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far beyond just a single lap,
the three of them kept running around the track until time ran out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tension had left Biwa Hayahide's shoulders,
and her running form had become beautifully refined.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: HAAAYAAAHIIIIIDEEEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Pumping yourself up with someone's name? Normal people don't do that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Tickeeet!! Taishiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hah!?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not bad at all.
The very act of raising one's voice affects motor unit recruitment, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Above all, calling out your names
fills me with power.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...What are you saying now, Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So? Are we gonna chase after that runaway girl who just dashed off?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Biwa Hayahide raced across the track
alongside Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The cheers from her friends seemed to provide Biwa Hayahide with great motivation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOO~~~~~~H!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, did I get something wrong?
Given how the conversation was going, though—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft, haha! You got it, you got it.
Well then, let's hurry up and run.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Catch ya later!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Th-That's not fair!!
Taishiiin~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well then, me too. Is that alright? Trainer-kun.
choice_data_list: Run with all your might and bring home the win!
Run with all your might and bring home the win!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Understood!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Biwa Hayahide chased after
Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin, who had run ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, she blew past the winning post in first place.
